# OverCue Desktop 2.2.29 for Windows

- DJM-V10 Stems EQ is now supported. Select DJM-V10 under Mixers and choose your original official 1.30 update to create the patched firmware locally. DJM-V10-LF is not supported.
- On the V10, HIGH controls Harmonics / Other, HI MID controls Vocals, LOW MID controls Drums, and LOW remains normal EQ. Requires prepared stems and V10-enabled OverCue CDJ-3000 firmware 0.13.2.
- Stem packaging uses more CPU cores when preparing one track at a time, helping finish batches sooner.
- Background processing gives the interface priority so the app stays responsive during preparation.
